correctness.rationale: For k>=ell>=1 and q=sqrt(t)>0 the centered Euclidean embedding certificates of squared edge lengths 1,1,q^2 yield the universal λ2<=1/Z bound by summing Rayleigh inequalities. In each regime, the supplied positive rates and Gram witness satisfy L0 X=X, budget Z, and λ2(L0)=1: below q_c interlacing of a grounded-star positive semidefinite principal block gives one negative eigenvalue of L0-I, and above q_c its 2x2 Schur complement has exactly one negative and one zero. Rate uniqueness follows because every leaf witness differs from its hub and equality fixes every pendant rate, then budget fixes the bridge. The positive-part correction gives continuous first but jumping second derivative, and eigen-multiplicity switches from k to one. Independently assembled full Laplacians satisfy the budget, exact predicted λ2 and eigenspace multiplicities in 108 test cases; symbolic certificate, not those samples, covers all k,ell,q.
